column1: # 🔴 THE FINDING IN THE PROBE ITSELF, AND IT OVERTURNS FOUR PASSES OF THIS BASE'S OWN READING.
# p378, p379, p380 and p381 each published `api.github.com  403` as ONE cell and read it as the
# integer-star channel being refused by a "sixth consecutive sandbox". That reading is wrong in a
# way that mattered: the host is NOT refusing. It is answering 200 on /rate_limit with a 15 000-unit
# AUTHENTICATED allowance, and refusing two OTHER path classes for two DIFFERENT, SELF-DECLARED
# reasons — one of which names its own remedy (`add_repo`) and one of which is a by-design closure
# ("sessions are bound to their configured repositories").
# 🔵 Why the distinction is load-bearing and not pedantry:
#   1. A rate-limit/blanket-block reading implies WAIT OR GIVE UP. A session-scope reading implies
#      a REMEDY EXISTS for the /repos class, and no pass has ever tried it. p382 tests it (p382-API).
#   2. The /search and /users closure is BY DESIGN and permanent in this harness. A successor that
#      keeps re-probing it every pass is spending a probe on a settled question. Record it CLOSED
#   3. `limit: 15000` is not an anonymous allowance (anonymous is 60/h). So a credential IS present
#      and is being scoped, not absent. "No API" was never the right description.
